title: TRIMMEAN rejects percent = 1 with #NUM! and sums kept values in original input order rather than sorted order
statement: In Excel 16.0.20430 and 16.0.20527, TRIMMEAN(array, percent) rejects percent = 1 with #NUM! (while accepting percent = 0.9999999999), and sums the untrimmed elements in their original input order rather than sorted order. On row 1142 of dcj9k_statistics, input-order addition yields 0x406ba50a3d70a3d8 (221.15750000000003) whereas adding the sorted kept slice gives 0x406ba50a3d70a3d7.
basis: Measured across 120 TRIMMEAN rows in dcj9k_statistics and prefix_metadata (row 233) in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 plus dc-6au controls in Excel 16.0.20430, and matched across 2,855/2,855 full-bank TRIMMEAN rows.

documentation.claim: Microsoft's TRIMMEAN documentation states that #NUM! is returned only when percent < 0 or percent > 1.
